title: Community Trading Bot
author: Jump_in_Jack
selftext:
Good morning! Just thought id chime in here about a community trading bot we are developing with it being added to playstore in the not so distant future and also auto build up donations to tree planting with a Solana ecosystem.

The current version 2.2.63 is sol tokens only and trades up to 6 tabs. Each tab has a recieve wallet and trade wallet that stays even if you close it to setup and trade a different token.

We do take a tiny fee per transaction as the grid ratchets back n forth. 1% minimum upto 5% if you set it higher (EXAMPLE: if you made 5% on a trade we take 1% of that 5% so its like a microtransaction and saves up til its big enough to be worth fees to send to us). It calculates this into your profitable trades as well as taxes and trade fees. So it wont make a trade unless you are in profit above taxes and our tiny trade fee to the sol ecosystem that gets put towards our goal of tree planting.

To make it simple its a grid bot. It trades on a 40% up and 40% down grid from center of the grid. You set the CA of the token you want to trade (make sure its right one) setup the parameters and then send sol to recieve wallet.

The bot then buys the token of choice with 50% of your sol and saves 50% for the buy side of the grid. This way the sell side has 50% in token and buy side has sol available to buy in small increments on way down.

The bot will ratchet back and forth if the price stays in the 40% up and 40% down range. Giving lots if breathing room to profit with small trades.

If the price goes up from center of range and passes the 40% upside and sells all your initial position it will rebuy and reanchor at center again at the new price and restart the grid from new price. If the price goes down below 40% from center of range your all in with all your sol and either have to wait for price to come back... or... you can activate the defense system we call cloning vats where you have extra saved up money to initiate buys. There is 5 vats and they are 50$ containers as a minimum and a max of whatever you like per container. When they activate they buy and when the price goes back above the vats they sell and fo back into the vat for later.

This grid bot is not reccomended for new meme tokens on Solana and more for established tokens. It wont allow you to buy tokens under 1k liquidity.

We have a kraken pro api coming where you will be able to have our bot run grid trading on other networks through kraken.

We have paper trading grid bot also coming so you can practice without money.

The bot also has built in CSV files for taxes and calculates taxes and sets that aside for you in usdc.

The bot has security keys just like phantom. So every user is responsible for their own security keys. 

The Bot also has a feature to add to a projects liquidity pool if users want to earn trade fees in that project also.

We also have a partnership program with a project mother bot system on the Solana side coming to help build an ecosystem where everyone helps everyone with their mother bots.

We have done hundreds of hours of testing to get here and continue to improve the features.

\- The current version is sol tokens only. Foundational for the sol partnership program and sol ecosystem.

Currently only supports WINDOWS and ANDROID.. sorry no apple yet.

COMING SOON 

 \- RPG adventure that incorporates grid bot trading

\- Kraken api for trading other coins like hbar, btc, eth etc

\- Paper trading so you can practice without money til you feel confident.

I have included a current screenshot of it running on my phone.. to show you the grid and some visual logic on the bot operations and partnership program.

Feel free to ask any questions. Or come join the discord for support and join our respectful and friendly community.

\~JiJ

Hope to see you around!
